messages:
mona_ae: Heads-up: Satellite Inc POC in us-west-2 reporting median TTFT ~950ms on short prompts (expect ~200-300ms). Also intermittent 429s when web clients spike. Demo in 36h, need quick triage. cc @diego_se @sam_sre

diego_se: Are they on Hosted? model name, concurrency, avg tokens? Any warmup done?

mona_ae: Hosted; model redwood-13b-compat; ~35 concurrent connections, avg prompt 25 tokens, context ~180 tokens. No warmup. Logs sanitized here: https://paste.example.com/satellite-poc

rachel_ml: Two common causes: (1) KV/prefix cache cold because each session uses unique convo keys, (2) batching H-O-L when short requests mix with long-context ones.

rachel_ml: Quick experiment: enable prefix_kv for their account and run a 5-request prefix warmup with a shared convo_key. Measure p50/p95 and batch queue_wait_ms.

sam_sre: Noted. There was a brief shard reassign in us-west-2 earlier but nothing persistent. 429s look like API-gateway per-account limits. I'll apply a soft quota bump for the demo window. quota_bot: "Applied soft quota bump: satellite -> 1600 r/min until 2026-04-05T04:00:00Z"

diego_se: If batching is the issue we can reduce max_batch_size for their route to lower queueing; set to 3 and re-run synthetic tests. Also capture avg_batch_size and queue_wait_ms.

mona_ae: Ran after config change: p50 down to ~280ms, p95 ~560ms. 429s still happen when frontend spikes >1.2k r/min.

diego_se: Good improvement. Remaining 429s are gateway-sourced. Options: front-end smoothing (token-bucket), temporary higher soft quota, or move demo traffic to Dedicated.

ben_devex: I'll draft a one-page POC playbook: warmup script, smoothing example (client-side token-bucket), recommended batch config, and quick cost delta for a 30m spike.

tara_sec: Satellite asked about CMK and log retention (90 days). Can we enable CMK for a hosted POC?

sam_sre: We can enable customer-managed keys for POC after a short infra review; 90-day retention configurable. I'll open the infra ticket and enable for the account once approved.

mona_ae: Customer also asked for rough pricing for a 30m spike to 5k r/min. Ben, can you supply a back-of-envelope?

ben_devex: Will DM numbers. Preview: hosted one-off spike cost > short Dedicated buffer; Dedicated reserve often reduces marginal costs for sustained/demo spikes.

diego_se: Action items: 1) Sam: infra ticket for CMK + soft quota (SUP-11021) 2) Rachel & Diego: finalize warmup script and batch tuning, post metrics 3) Ben: POC playbook + cost delta 4) Tara: security answers draft. Schedule dry-run in 12h.

mona_ae: Thanks team 44d. I'll update Satellite and block the dry-run slot.
